notes.printed: All times are UTC. The lock tag times, and the commit times of the puzzle sets, Addendum C4, the record merge and the price-date commit, are git's tagger and committer times, as re-read from git in our final fact-check; the commit times of the length pick and of Study 1's k.json are from our own process record; run times are from our records of each run (a logged span starts when the run's command started, before its first call); the exposure scan's time is the Lock 4 manifest's; posting, snapshot and archive times are the public records' own. A date is printed on the first row of each UTC day; the rows below it fall on the same day. A row with no time is a ruling, or a run or step whose record gives only its date; it sits in order between the rows around it.
